titles.romaji: Elf-sensei no Toire wa Doko desu ka?
titles.native: エルフ先生のトイレはどこですか？

description:
Eruru, an elf from another world who has come to a human boys' school as an intern teacher, is troubled by the elven rule that one must go the bathroom in a place with abundant nature.

(Source: Natalie, translated)
